mapper.sql: select k.id, k.user_id as userId, u.username, k.name, k.access_key as accessKey, k.status, p.id as modelPackageId, p.package_name as modelPackageName, g.id as modelGroupId, g.group_name as modelGroupName, k.total_quota as totalQuota, k.used_quota as usedQuota, k.expires_at as expiresAt, k.last_used_at as lastUsedAt, k.created_at as createdAt from api_keys k join users u on u.id = k.user_id left join user_model_packages p on p.id = k.user_package_id left join model_groups g on g.id = k.model_group_id
mapper.select: where k.deleted = 0 order by k.id desc
where k.deleted = 0 and k.user_id = #{userId} order by k.id desc
